apps.name: Caterpillar
apps.subtitle: Windows 11 on ARM, on iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription: Runs Windows 11 for ARM64 with its own JIT. Bring your own Windows disk image. Needs JIT (StikDebug) and an 8 GB device for comfortable use.

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Lets apps in Windows hear the microphone.

apps.name: GestaltX
apps.subtitle: An MobileGestalt editor for iOS 27.x, featuring region-code tweaks, device presets, backups, and support for 7 languages.
apps.localizedDescription: An MobileGestalt editor for iOS 27.x, featuring region-code tweaks, device presets, backups, and support for 7 languages.

versions.localizedDescription:
upstream: v1.0.5

GestaltX v1.0.5 from huamidev/GestaltX with South Korea (KH) added to the region code options.

Unsigned. Sideload it over the existing GestaltX to update in place.

apps.name: StikContainer
apps.subtitle: LiveContainer + SideStore with built-in StikJIT
apps.localizedDescription: LiveContainer+SideStore nightly with built-in StikJIT JIT enabling, rebuilt automatically

versions.localizedDescription:
upstream: 9d6ea09

LiveContainer+SideStore nightly 3.8.13 (upstream commit 9d6ea09) with the built-in StikJIT JIT enabler.

Unsigned. Sideload it over an existing LiveContainer with the same Apple ID to update in place.
